diagnostics.message: google_compute_organization_security_policy_association.attachment attaches firewall policies by ID taken only from var.firewall_policy_attachments, with no reference to the policies created in this module. Since association creation calls the addAssociation API against the policy, each policy in google_compute_organization_security_policy.policy must exist before its association is created; without an explicit depends_on the associations may be applied before the policies, causing API errors on create and premature deletion ordering on destroy.
